title: Undercity
body: Beneath the broken capital of Lordaeron lies the Undercity, seat of the Forsaken. The old kingdom kept its royal crypts, catacombs and sewers here, and the Scourge began carving them into a stronghold before Arthas was called north. When Sylvanas Windrunner broke free and turned on the dreadlords who held the ruins, her Forsaken claimed the warren and finished it as their own, quarter by quarter around the Trade Quarter at its heart.

parts.body: At the Dark Lady's side stands the dreadlord Varimathras, who begged for his life when her Forsaken broke his forces and swore himself to her service.
Orcs of the Kor'kron, the Warchief's own guard, now walk the city's halls, sent by Thrall to reinforce it while its army fights in Northrend, and to keep watch on the Forsaken.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Undercity (origins as royal crypts, catacombs, dungeons and sewers; poorest citizens lived there; Arthas left it unfinished; Forsaken completed it; quarter layout; elevators exit at Trade Quarter)

title: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner
body: Once Ranger-General of Silvermoon, Sylvanas Windrunner fell defending Quel'Thalas from Arthas and was raised as a banshee in his service. When the Lich King's grip faltered she broke free, turned on the dreadlords who held Lordaeron and named her freed undead the Forsaken. She rules them from the Royal Quarter.

parts.body: In recent years she has championed the blood elves of Quel'Thalas, once her own people, and stood for their entry into the Horde while others doubted them.

When a necklace from Windrunner Spire was laid before her, a gift from her sister Alleria, she scorned it as a long dead memory and let it fall. A moment later she knelt, took it up again and whispered Belore.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Sylvanas_Windrunner (Ranger-General, raised by Arthas, broke free, dreadlords, blood elves, Battle for the Undercity)

parts.body: After the Wrathgate her own court turned on her: Varimathras and Grand Apothecary Putress seized the Undercity, and the Dark Lady, nearly killed, fled to Orgrimmar.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Sylvanas_Windrunner (Ranger-General, raised by Arthas, broke free, dreadlords, blood elves, Battle for the Undercity)

parts.body: She came home at Thrall's side, fought down through her fallen city, and took back the throne where Varimathras fell.

title: Varimathras
body: Varimathras was one of three dreadlord brothers who ruled Lordaeron's undead for the Burning Legion after Arthas went north. When Sylvanas broke his forces he begged for his life and offered his service, and for years he stood at her side in the Royal Quarter as her lieutenant.

parts.body: His loyalty was a mask. After the Wrathgate he and Putress seized the Undercity and filled its halls with demons and blight.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Varimathras (brothers Balnazzar and Detheroc, begged Sylvanas for his life, lieutenant, coup, unseen Master)

parts.body: Cornered in the throne room by Thrall and Sylvanas, he opened portals for his demon kin and begged pardon of an unseen master, then fell with a last gasp: years, wasted.

title: Grand Apothecary Putress
body: Grand Apothecary Putress rose to the head of the Royal Apothecary Society by vowing to Sylvanas to take the plague that made the Forsaken and make it their weapon. At the Wrathgate in Northrend he turned his New Plague on Alliance, Horde and Scourge alike, striking down Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and many soldiers of both sides.

parts.body: King Varian's forces cornered him in the Apothecarium among his blight generators. He swore it would not end like this after so many years of work, and died there.
